title: An incremental approximation to the prime-counting function via polygonal numbers
summary: We construct an incremental prime-counting approximation from corrected right-endpoint sums on polygonal-number partitions. For each fixed polygonal family, retaining completed contributions gives $\mathcal O(1)$ numerical operations per consecutive node and $\mathcal O(\sqrt X)$ operations for the full traversal through $X$, in the unit-cost model. The scheme uses a fixed number of working numerical words rather than repeated summation. Asymptotic formulas for the discretization error and terminal scale yield an unconditional relation with the classical normalized prime-counting error. We…
